correctness.rationale: The 28 facets partition into seven independent four-triangle tetrahedral boundaries. Every missing line triangle is integrally filled using an external point, giving H1=0 and rank 15 for the signed 21x28 boundary, so H2 is free rank 13. Seven disjoint-support cycles admit a 7x7 unimodular coordinate minor and hence span a saturated rank-seven subgroup, leaving a free six-dimensional quotient. A four-supported integral two-cycle must be one tetrahedral boundary by edge cancellation; the only such four-subsets are complements of the seven Fano lines. Exact independent Lefschetz traces and direct action on a rational cycle basis agree on six conjugacy classes of all 168 matrices. The standard group table then proves the 7 plus conjugate-3 rational decomposition. All assertions are specific to the 7-point complex.

value.rationale: The Fano matroid is the smallest binary projective plane and the naturally distinguished top-dimensional tetrahedral sphere cycles are canonical under all collineations. The result establishes that these seven shortest cycles simultaneously partition all facets, form an integral primitive group-stable sublattice and leave an irreducible six-dimensional rational quotient. This new geometric-versus-exceptional representation distinction is absent from mere Betti numbers and is mathematically motivated as a natural equivariant homology invariant of the Fano plane, not a parameter sweep or table recomputation.
